name: koubou
description: Fabio Ueno's Claude Code plugins, one job each.

plugins.name: crew
plugins.description: A side panel with a card for each agent at work: the main loop and every subagent, with its model, task, current tool and context use.

plugins.name: ember
plugins.description: Keeps the prompt cache warm while you are away, with a short ping before it would expire, and warns when a resumed session's cache has gone cold.

plugins.name: git
plugins.description: Git housekeeping, starting with .gitignore files built from the official templates.

plugins.name: kanso
plugins.description: Explanations in simplified technical English, delivered as HTML pages with diagrams.

plugins.name: ribbon
plugins.description: A band above the prompt with the session's time, cost, project, branch and rate limits.
